name: Démara
summary: Demara is distinguished by a zebra-patterned wood veneer top, its bold grain creating a surface alive with natural rhythm and contrast. The design is anchored by a metal base finished in brushed brass with straight veins, adding warmth and luminous depth. With its sculptural balance and refined detailing, it stands as a statement of modern elegance shaped by the artistry of natural materials. 240x110x76
